content.text: The data clearly shows that **only Zone_F2_Z01's** cooling setpoint dropped ~1 C in mid-June (cooling setpoint 24.65→23.58, heating setpoint and occupied cooling setpoint all shifted with it, temperature ~1 C lower), while the other core zones F3_Z01 and F4_Z01 kept their setpoints flat. A schedule change is a global, building/system-wide change that would affect all zones; a controller offset / local override is zone-specific. The data show one zone changed in isolation, supporting the local controller offset explanation.
